import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();
        System.out.println(compute(p, k));
    }

    static long compute(int p, int k) {
        if (k == 0) {
            return modPow(p, p - 1, MOD);
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            return modPow(p, p, MOD);
        }
        int order = 1;
        long cur = k % p;
        while (cur != 1) {
            cur = (cur * k) % p;
            order++;
        }
        int exponent = (p - 1) / order;
        return modPow(p, exponent, MOD);
    }

    // Modular exponentiation: base^exp % mod
    static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
